description: This file is a FastAPI router module implementing a backend API for a branding compliance analysis system. It defines data models, route handlers, and logic for managing jobs, uploading assets, initiating analysis, retrieving results, fixing assets, and downloading reports. The code interacts with various services, models, and storage paths, facilitating file uploads, analysis triggers, status checks, and asset previews within a structured backend API framework.

classes.name: CreateJobRequest
classes.description: Model for creating a new job, with optional owner, title, and description.

classes.name: CreateJobResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the created job ID.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: Model representing the status response of a job, including progress and issue counts.

classes.name: FixAssetRequest
classes.description: Model for requesting to fix a single asset.

classes.name: BatchFixRequest
classes.description: Model for requesting batch fixes for assets.

methods.name: create_job(data: CreateJobRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new job, initializing workspace and storing job data.

methods.name: delete_job(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a job and its workspace.

methods.name: upload_assets_zip(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to upload a zip of assets, extract, and store references.

methods.name: upload_old_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to upload an old brand reference image.

methods.name: upload_new_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to upload a new brand reference image.

methods.name: analyze_job(job_id: str, background: BackgroundTasks, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to trigger background analysis and preview generation.

methods.name: get_status(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve current job progress and status.

methods.name: get_results(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to list assets and issues for a job.

methods.name: get_asset_preview( job_id: str, asset_id: str, view: Literal["original", "overlay", "fixed"] = Query("original", description="Preview type"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve preview files for assets in different views.

methods.name: fix_single_asset(job_id: str, asset_id: str, req: FixAssetRequest, request: Request, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to run an automatic fix on a specific asset.

methods.name: batch_fix(job_id: str, req: BatchFixRequest, request: Request, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to run automatic fixes on all assets with issues.

methods.name: download_artifacts( job_id: str, type: Literal["zip", "report", "both"] = Query("zip", description="Artifact type to download"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Endpoint to download report or zip artifacts of a job.
